ratios.facility: credit facilities (term loan B and revolving credit facility)
ratios.quote: As of September 30, 2026, our first-lien leverage ratio was 2.0 times.

parsed.notes: The first-lien leverage ratio is calculated net of consolidated unrestricted cash, divided by trailing four-quarter consolidated EBITDA as defined in the credit agreement, and is tested quarterly. The 5.0x limit comes from the sentence: "consisting of a maximum first-lien leverage ratio of 5.0 times." The total leverage ratio mentioned only sets the revolver interest margin and is excluded. The senior notes indenture covenants are non-financial and are also excluded. The company states it was in compliance as of September 30, 2026.
